```{r}
library(dplyr) 
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)
library(ggpubr)
library(reshape2)
library(data.table)
library(rstatix)
library(tidyr)

```


```{r}
default_directory <- "C:\\Users\\Samantha\\Claycomb Lab Dropbox\\Claycomb Lab Team Folder\\Sebastian Fuentes\\Grad School\\Reasearch Project\\Images\\Mutant D2005 Images\\Confocal\\TIFFs\\"

date <- c("July6", "July21")

#Initialize empty dataframes with column names
#for all the data
df <- data.frame()
#for the means per well (just in case)
quants_df <- data.frame(Strain = character(), Range = character(), Rep = character(), meanIntDen = numeric())

for (r in 1:2){
  # Define the directory containing your .txt files
  meas_directory <- paste0(default_directory,date[r],"")

# Get a list of all .txt files in the directory
  file_list <- list.files(meas_directory, pattern = ".txt$", full.names = TRUE, recursive=TRUE)

# Loop through each txt file
  for (file in file_list) {
  # Read the contents of the txt file
    data <- fread(file, header = TRUE)
  
  # Extract strain and rep from the file name
    file_name <- basename(file)
    strain <- gsub("(.*?)_.*", "\\1", file_name)
    rep <- as.integer(gsub(".*_(.*?)_.*\\.txt", "\\1", file_name))
    fluorange <- gsub(".*_(.*?)\\.txt", "\\1", file_name)
  
  # Add strain and rep to the data frame
    data$Strain <- strain
    if (r==1){
      data$Rep <- as.character(rep)
    }
    else{
       data$Rep <- as.character(rep + 3)
    }
    data$Range <- fluorange
  
  # Combine the data with the existing data frame
    df <- rbind(df, data)
  }
}

IntDenByRep <- df %>%
  group_by(Strain, Rep, Range) %>%
  summarise(meanIntDen = mean(IntDen, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Range,
    values_from = meanIntDen
  )

```

integrated density is mean gray * area

```{r}
ggplot(IntDenByRep, aes(x=lower, y=higher, color=Strain)) +
  geom_point(size=5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,750)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,750)) +
  geom_abline(intercept=0, slope=1, color="darkgray", linetype="dashed")+
  theme_classic(base_family="sans") +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=12),
        axis.text.y=element_text(size=12),
        aspect.ratio = 1) +
  labs(y="Germ granule GFP Integrated Density",
       x="Cytoplasmic GFP Integrated Density") 

ggsave(file=paste0(default_directory,"GGvsCytoPlot_07242026.svg"))
```
